generated_response: Veto power is the right of a leader or body to stop or override an action or decision made by another group or entity. In democratic systems, veto power can be used to challenge decisions that they believe are unfair or harmful. It is often used in conjunction with other powers, such as the power of the majority to approve certain legislation, to ensure that important decisions are not made without input from all parties involved.
